g.text: May cause an allergic skin reaction. Toxic to aquatic life with long lasting effects.
Contains: Terpinolene, d-Limonene, dl-Limonene, p-Mentha-1,3-dieneMay produce an allergic reaction.

Avoid breathing vapours and dust. Avoid release to the environment. IF ON SKIN: wash with plenty of water. If skin irritation or rash occurs:get medical advice. Collect spillage. Dispose of contents and container in accordance with local regulations.
